AlertsPage.description: One page of alerts, by name, and how many match in all.

history.description:
The turns before this one. The service keeps no session, so the panel
sends the thread back; without it the model answered a follow-up with
no idea what came before it.

ConditionShape.description: Which rows must pass, and the test each row takes.

rows.description:
`one`: the metric must answer exactly one row, and it must pass.
`any`, `all`, `none`: of the rows answered. `{"count": {"op": ">",
"value": 3}}`: the number of passing rows, compared. `any` over no
rows is not met; `all` and `none` over no rows are unknown.

where.description:
A test on one column, or a group of tests. Groups nest at most 3
deep and hold at most 20 tests in all.

name.description:
What a reader calls it: trimmed, 1 to 128 characters, and shared by
as many definitions as like.

DrilldownBody.description:
What a caller may ask a page for. An absent body asks for the first page
of the whole result, in the metric's own order.

name.description: What the copy is called: trimmed, 1 to 128 characters.

EnabledRequest.description: Turning a rule on or off names the revision it expects to change.

level.description:
`viewer` or `editor`. An editor who is not an administrator only
views.

LeafShape.description:
One test on one result column. Which operators apply depends on what
the column holds: a number takes `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `==`, `!=`,
`between`; text takes `==`, `!=`, `contains`, `starts_with`,
`ends_with`, `in`, `not_in`, comparing exactly; a date takes `before`,
`after`, `between`, `older_than`, `newer_than`.

column.description: The result column, by the `as_name` the metric gives it.

value.description:
A number, or an integer written as digits; text up to 256
characters; an RFC 3339 timestamp; a list of two for `between`; a
list of 1 to 50 texts for `in` and `not_in`; a duration such as
`P7D`, `P2W`, `PT6H` or `PT30M` for `older_than` and `newer_than`,
measured back from the check.

oneOf.description: Met when every test in it is.
Met when one test in it is.
Met when the test in it is not.

condition.description: The condition the notification was owed under.

context_columns.description: The columns the rule asked the witness to keep beside the condition's.

metric.description: The id of the metric checked.

metric_name.description:
What the metric was called when the notification was owed; null
where only its id is known.

witness.description: The rows the check saw that owed it.

NotificationsPage.description: One page of a rule's notifications, newest first.

PreviewDraft.description:
What the form asks before a rule is saved: what a check of this metric,
window and condition would find now.

condition.description: Which rows must pass, and the test each row takes.

context_columns.description: Result columns to show beside the condition's, as a rule names them.

metric.description: The id of the stored metric to check.

range.description:
The window the metric is run over, as a rule names it. Omit it to
run the metric unbounded.

PreviewResponse.description: What a check of the draft would find now. Nothing is recorded.

reason.description: Why the check could not tell; null unless the outcome is `unknown`.

oneOf.description: The rows judged; null when the outcome is `unknown`.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem+json. `context` varies by error category.

dataset.description: The dataset this record belongs to, which must already be declared.

RuleDraft.description: A rule as an administrator writes it.

condition.description: Which rows must pass, and the test each row takes.

context_columns.description:
Result columns, by `as_name`, shown beside the condition's in every
notification: up to 5.

destination.description: The configured destination the notification goes to.

enabled.description:
Whether checks run. Left out, a new alert is enabled and a replaced
one keeps what it had.

expected_revision.description:
The revision this write expects to replace. Required to change an
alert that exists; refused when creating one.

interval_secs.description: How often to check, in seconds.

metric.description: The id of the stored metric to check.

name.description: What the alert is called, as people read it: up to 200 characters.

range.description:
The window the metric is run over, as `run_metric` takes it. Omit it
to run the metric unbounded.

RuleResponse.description: A rule as a reader is shown it.

condition.description:
As a draft writes it. A number past ±(2^53 − 1) is a digit string,
which a JavaScript reader would otherwise round; a draft takes it
back as it is.

context_columns.description: Result columns the witness keeps beside the condition's.

id.description: The handle every other operation takes.

StateResponse.description:
What the latest checks left: when, what was found, and whether the
last valid check saw the condition met.

last_outcome.description: `breach`, `no_breach` or `unknown`; absent before the first check.

oneOf.description: The rows the last valid check judged; absent while it was unknown.

SummaryResponse.description: One alert as a listing shows it.

tags.description:
Every tag the dashboard carries from now on, each trimmed to 1 to 32
characters, at most 10; `[]` clears them.

to.description: The person id of the current administrator to own it from now on.

Turn.description:
One turn of the conversation so far. The reader's panel keeps the thread
and sends it back, because the service stores no session.

role.description: `user` or `assistant`; anything else is dropped before the call.

WitnessResponse.description:
The rows a check judged: how many passed of how many, and up to five of
them, holding the metric's group-by columns, then the columns the
condition reads, then the rule's context columns.

rows.description:
One list of cells per row, in `columns` order, as the run answered
them; text is cut to 256 characters.
